estimates: The model represents the standing marble-clad cathedral after the west and central glazing changes. The bell tower and dome heights, window spacing and joinery are working estimates.
The source survey records the surveyed form in writing. Exterior visual estimates include the western trim, steel-and-glass bell crowns, marble joints and main roof pitch.

The coarse source ground remains original. Site grade, stair depth and foundation registration are approximate. The detached courtyard monument, precinct wall and Prelacy offices are outside the scope.

review.notes: Searched published Qualla originals first. The unknown-photographer street view lacks primary publication evidence and the interior painting does not show the exterior. The model uses the measured footprint and first-hand written architectural sources.
